chapter_note: Pure cosmological substrate throughout. The chapter is structured by the repeated formula "Beforehand, before X happened, Y was established" (ⲍⲁⲧⲉⲍⲏ ⲉⲙⲡⲁⲧⲉ...) — a systematic teaching of pre-cosmic establishments: the three fossae, the wall in the great sea, the place for the Enthumesis-fallen, the binding of Error and dregs of Darkness, the place of the archonic host, the prison of the Watchers, the twelve cities of the Giants. Voice is impersonal-structural, both sides of every mapping internal to the cosmic system. No dialogue frame, no exhortation, no ecclesial or polemical material. Heavy physical damage (69.6%) preserves the structural skeleton clearly. Teaching purity 1.000.
